statement_definition_check.assumptions: Natural n,d with 3<=n<=d; k=d/n=floor(d/n); real kappa>=4; arbitrary O_j in O(n). No n divisibility, common determinant sign, independence, query budget, Haar distribution, or extra spectral-bound premise is introduced.
statement_definition_check.definition_semantics: Sealed contiguous coordinate map sends (inner,block) to inner+n*block and tail index t to k*n+t. The residual d%n equals d-k*n. The literal block matrix has A_Oj diagonal blocks, zero cross blocks, and identity residual block. This matches Eq5 and its empty-tail convention.
statement_definition_check.regularity: Real Hermitian is real symmetric. Universal quadratic comparisons plus symmetry are exactly the source family membership, using positive-semidefinite Loewner order.
statement_definition_check.minimizer: f0=0 and all-vector nonnegativity with f x=0 iff x=0 establish existence of the actual minimizer zero, attained minimum value zero, and uniqueness. This is stronger than a bare minimizer-existence token and matches the source.

findings.detail: All 22 edges point from ingredients to their actual source consumers. All multi-input edges are true conjunctions within one source route; no two sufficient alternatives are flattened into a false AND.

The endpoint node is explicit coverage bookkeeping for the same universal finite-sum argument. It need not be an extra premise of regularity. With k*n=d, residual dimension and tail sums are zero; without divisibility, the identity residual contributes its squared norm.

The route_logic summary says full regularity -> potential positivity. The actual source proof and the authoritative edge list correctly consume only the full lower quadratic bound for positivity; upper bound and symmetry are unnecessary there. Read the prose as a chronological summary, not an additional mandatory edge.
